backlogged.summary: fillTree finds the entry to update by base, command and rule, so it can update a different entry than the one cachedEntry returned if the file has duplicate keys. Duplicates are not expected, so this is harmless today.
The AC-3 and ES-1 tests inject the git failure with a POSIX shell script and return early on Windows, so those criteria are not exercised on Windows CI.
A failed tree key computation is retried for every cacheTree call within a verify. Only the warning is deduplicated, so a persistent git failure repeats the git call.
